title: Sign in
caption: Each person picks their name, types their own PIN on the keypad and presses Unlock. What they can see and do depends on their role. Wrong PINs are counted; too many lock the account for a while.

title: Your shop details
caption: Admin → System & Backups. The company name, address, phone, email and logo here are printed on every bill. Opening cash and opening bank are the money you start with on day one. App mode stays on Simple billing.

title: Staff and PINs
caption: Admin → User Accounts. Add each person with their own PIN and a role: Operator (makes bills and takes payments), Manager (also prices, credit overrides, accounts), Admin (everything). Change the default PIN 7860 on day one.

title: Home
caption: The first screen every day: today's sales, cash received, expenses and money in the business; the four everyday buttons; recent bills; and anything that needs attention, such as low stock.

title: The price list
caption: Items & Prices: every item with its fixed selling price and stock. The tin is red because stock is below its warning level.

title: Add an item
caption: Name, what it is sold per (can, tin, bag, kg…), the fixed selling price, the cost price (for profit), stock on hand and the low-stock warning level.

title: Turn on batch and expiry
caption: For goods that expire, like oil and ghee, tick "Track batch & expiry" on the item. From then on its stock is received in batches, each with its own expiry date.

title: Receive stock
caption: When goods arrive: quantity, batch number and expiry date. With the supplier and the cost, the purchase is also added to what you owe that supplier.

title: Batches and expiry dates
caption: The item now shows each batch with its expiry. Amber means it expires within 30 days, red means expired. Expired stock is flagged and can never be sold.

title: Godowns
caption: If stock is kept in more than one place, add each godown. The main godown always exists; a godown holding stock can't be deleted.

title: Move stock
caption: Move stock between godowns. The total never changes; batches keep their number and expiry.

title: Stock per godown
caption: With two godowns, each item shows how much is in each place.

title: Add a customer
caption: Name and phone are enough. A credit limit is optional: leave it empty for no limit. With a limit, bills that would take them over it are stopped unless a manager allows it.

title: Customers
caption: Every customer with what they owe. The bill icon on a row starts a new bill for that customer.

title: Step 1: New Bill
caption: Press New Bill. One empty line, today's date.

title: Step 2: customer and item
caption: Pick the customer and the item: its fixed price fills in. For batch items the line shows which batches will be used: the earliest expiry first (50 from B-0911, then 10 from B-0926).

title: Step 3: more lines, change a price
caption: Add another item for each line. The tin price was changed to 6,500 for this bill only; the item keeps its normal price.

title: Step 4: discount and payment
caption: Discount, then what the customer paid. "Full" fills the whole amount; pick the method (Cash, Bank Transfer, Cheque, Easypaisa / JazzCash, Card). Whatever is not paid goes on the customer's account.

title: Step 5: the printed bill
caption: Save & Print opens the printout: your logo and details, Bill From / Bill To, Description · Qty · Price · Amount, the batch used under each batch item, and the total. "Print / Save PDF" to print or send on WhatsApp.

title: Home after the first bill
caption: Sales, cash received and the recent bills list update straight away. One Save did everything: stock came off, the cash book and the accounts were posted.

title: Over the credit limit
caption: Limited Traders has a Rs. 10,000 limit and already owes 8,000. This bill would take them over, so Save is blocked. Take more payment now, or…

title: Manager allows it
caption: …a manager or admin ticks "Allow over limit" and writes a reason. The reason is saved on the bill and in the audit log. Operators can't do this.

title: Bills
caption: Every bill, newest first: search by number, customer, phone or item; Today / 7 days / This month / All; CSV download. Amber means money is still due.

title: Unpaid bills
caption: The Unpaid filter shows only bills with money due.

title: Open a bill
caption: Lines, total, paid and balance, what the customer owes on all bills, payments taken, and the Receive payment form.

title: Take a payment later
caption: 3,000 received by Easypaisa. The balance drops and the payment is listed. Easypaisa and bank transfers go to the bank side of the cash book; cash goes to cash in hand.

title: One customer
caption: What they owe against their limit, every bill, money received, and the buttons: New bill, Receive payment, Statement, Edit.

title: Customer statement
caption: A printable statement of account: every bill and payment with a running balance.

section: Expenses, cash and the daily sheet
title: Add an expense
caption: The category buttons on the daily sheet open the form with the category and date set. Each category is its own expense sheet. "Credit (unpaid)" records something you still owe.

section: Expenses, cash and the daily sheet
title: Cash ↔ Bank
caption: Deposit cash in the bank or withdraw it. The buttons show what is in the drawer and in the bank; you can't move more than you have.

section: Expenses, cash and the daily sheet
title: The daily sheet
caption: One page for the whole day: opening and closing cash and bank, every bill, every rupee received, expenses by sheet, supplier payments and deposits. Count the drawer against "Closing cash".

section: Expenses, cash and the daily sheet
title: Print the daily sheet
caption: Print it at closing time, with Prepared by / Checked by lines.

title: Where the money is
caption: Cash in hand, bank, what customers owe you and what you owe: suppliers, unpaid expenses and any customer advances. "Money in the business" adds them up.

title: Opening balances
caption: The cash and bank you started with, and the date to count from. Set once on day one.

title: Monthly expense sheets
caption: One sheet per category for the month, with every entry and its total.

title: Cash book
caption: Every rupee in and out this month, with its method.

title: Check your bank statement
caption: Money → Bank reconciliation. Bring in your bank's statement and the app pairs each line with the bank entries already in your books.

title: Upload the statement
caption: Upload the CSV from your bank (comma, semicolon or tab separated). The columns are guessed; change them if needed.

title: Matched automatically
caption: Each line is matched to your books by amount and date (within 3 days). Lines not in your books are marked in amber.

title: Add what is missing
caption: A customer's bank transfer: "Received from" picks the customer (guessed from the bank text). Recording it reduces what they owe. Unknown money goes to Suspense for your accountant.

title: Reconciled ✓
caption: Type the closing balance from the statement. When the books and the bank agree it shows Reconciled ✓. Cheques not yet cleared are listed; tick them once they appear.

title: Reconciliation report
caption: Save it, and print the reconciliation for your records or your accountant.

title: Trial balance
caption: Accounts is for the owner and the accountant. Every bill, payment, expense, purchase and transfer is posted here automatically. The trial balance shows every account; debits must equal credits: Balanced ✓.

title: General ledger
caption: Click any account to see every entry with a running balance. Bill numbers open the bill itself.

title: Journal
caption: Every entry, automatic and manual, filterable.

title: Manual journal entry
caption: The accountant can post their own entries. It only saves when debits equal credits; one account on both sides or a future date is refused.

title: Chart of accounts
caption: The accounts money is sorted into, set up for a Pakistani trading shop. Add your own (a second bank, say); system accounts can't be deleted. Admins can close a finished period here so nothing dated in it can change.

title: Profit & Loss
caption: Sales, less the cost of what was sold (from the actual batch or purchase cost), less expenses. Did the business make money this period?

title: Balance sheet
caption: What the business owns against what it owes and what belongs to the owner. Balanced ✓.

title: Printed accounts
caption: The trial balance, Profit & Loss and balance sheet all print.

title: Suppliers
caption: Who you buy from and what you owe them. Stock received with a supplier and a cost is added here automatically; record payments to them here.

title: Audit trail
caption: Every bill, payment, expense, deletion, credit override and setting change, with who did it and when.

title: Roles and permissions
caption: What each role may do. Deleting, overriding credit limits, posting journals and bank reconciliation are for managers and admins.

title: One tap to the full suite
caption: For bigger operations: bookings, truck dispatches with weighbridge and freight, purchase orders, fleet and drivers, stock flow and price history, sales analytics. Same data underneath.

title: Back to simple billing
caption: One tap brings the simple screens back.
